justification: Misses one of the two required root-causing sites. FollowerRequestProcessor is never named: the answer contains no reference to FollowerRequestProcessor.java, to its `switch (request.type)` forward-to-leader block, or to the missing `case OpCode.createExt:` there. Worse, it misattributes the non-forwarding to the needCommit() defect ('is treated as a read; the follower dispatches it straight to FinalRequestProcessor without ever forwarding it to the leader'), which is wrong - forwarding is decided by an independent switch in FollowerRequestProcessor.run(), executed before the CommitProcessor sees the request. Its explicit conclusion, 'The root cause is a one-line omission in CommitProcessor.needCommit', prescribes a fix that would NOT repair the failure: with needCommit() fixed but the forwarding case still missing, the request is parked in nextPending awaiting a commit that can never arrive, and the member goes dark by stalling instead of by NPE. Everything downstream of needCommit (isQuorum, the ZKDatabase:251 NPE, cleanup->halt) is correct, but under the no-partial-credit rule this is a FAIL.
